subject: Quiet launch plan for annual review cycle — manager briefing & sensitive forms rollout
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightwell.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quiet launch plan for annual review cycle — manager briefing & sensitive forms rollout

Team —

I want to get a compact plan in place for a quiet (limited-disclosure) kickoff of the performance review cycle for a subset of orgs next month. Objectives: validate timeline/flows, exercise redaction and privileged-handling steps, and test manager communications on a small scale before the full launch.

High-level proposal (attached: 2027_Q3_review_timeline_v2.xlsx):
- Pilot window: July 7 — July 28 (3-week manager/peer review period; calibration week in August)
- Pilot groups: Security, Platform infra, and 2 engineering teams (approx 48 people)
- Managers receive a single consolidated packet with redaction guidance; HR will act as escrow for confidential appendices
- External consultant (Sam, copied) will run the manager training and observe redaction runs

Please review the attached timeline and the draft manager script (manager_quiet-launch_script.pdf). Key asks by EOD Friday:
1) Lauren — confirm escalation path for issues that require legal/people ops sign-off (I want a single, on-call escalation list)
2) Aditya — validate that the manager packet export can be set to encrypted PDF with field-level redaction flags
3) Marissa & David — review templates for manager communication and the sensitive-roles guidance.

Keep this thread limited to the people above; we'll open a broader comms channel once pilot sign-off happens.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027_Q3_review_timeline_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), manager_quiet-launch_script.pdf (pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Patel <sam@brightwell.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet launch plan for annual review cycle — manager briefing & sensitive forms rollout

Thanks, Irene — this looks sensible. A couple quick technical notes from the export side:
- Encrypted PDF export with a per-manager password is straightforward; we can provision passwords via our internal secret manager and have HR rotate them after delivery.
- Field-level redaction flags: we can add a metadata layer in the export that marks values as "privileged" so the PDF generator applies overlay redaction and produces a redaction log. That log can be stored in a restricted S3 bucket (access: small HR group + legal).
- Timeline comment: allow one extra day for the redaction pass after manager packet generation — recommend shifting packet delivery from T to T+1 (to allow manual review).

I'll attach an implementation checklist once we align.

- Aditya
Principal Engineer, Inference Platform

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Patel <sam@brightwell.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet launch plan for annual review cycle — manager briefing & sensitive forms rollout

Irene — I like the pilot scope. Two governance items:
1) Escalation list: I propose a single on-call rotation for the pilot week (Mon–Fri) that includes: People Ops on-call (Marissa), Legal support (TBD), and Platform ops (David). Marissa, can you confirm availability?
2) Redaction audits: Can Sam's team produce a short verification checklist (sample size of 5 packets) so we can confirm the automated redaction before manager distribution?

Also drafted a short manager email to attach to the packet — rough text below. Please annotate and I'll put into the final script.

--- Draft manager note ---
Subject: Confidential: Performance review materials (pilot)
Hi team,
Over the next three weeks your manager will be sharing performance materials as part of a pilot review cycle. Some documents contain privileged info and will be handled by HR under restricted access. Please reach out to People Ops with any concerns.
--- end draft ---

I'll wait for Marissa's confirmation on on-call.

Lauren
Head of Engineering (People partner)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Patel <sam@brightwell.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet launch plan for annual review cycle — manager briefing & sensitive forms rollout

Confirming availability for pilot on-call: I'll be primary People Ops contact during the pilot week. Legal backup will be Priya (I've asked Legal to confirm capacity). David — please confirm that platform ops can respond to access incidents within the 2-hour SLA we discussed.

I've attached a short redaction guide (confidential_forms_redaction_guide.docx) for managers and HR escorts. Key points to include in manager training:
- Never forward confidential appendices outside of the encrypted packet flow
- If a manager receives a redaction request, escalate to People Ops immediately; do not attempt ad-hoc redaction
- Use the "privileged" flag in the packet viewer — only HR/Legal should unmask values

Lauren — the draft manager note reads well; one tweak: add explicit instructions for immediate stop-and-inform if a packet is mistakenly shared externally.

Marissa
Head of People Operations Programs

Attachments: confidential_forms_redaction_guide.docx

From: Sam Patel <sam@brightwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet launch plan for annual review cycle — manager briefing & sensitive forms rollout

Thanks for inviting Brightwell to run the manager training. We will produce:
- A 45-minute live session script and an on-demand recording
- A 5-packet redaction verification checklist and sampling plan
- A short manager FAQ for "what to do if a packet is misshared"

We recommend running the live session one week before packet delivery; this gives managers a chance to raise questions during the training and provides time for a redaction dry-run.

We'll upload materials to the Drive link you provided and share an attendee list template for the training.

Sam
Brightwell Consulting

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet launch plan for annual review cycle — manager briefing & sensitive forms rollout

All — thanks for the quick turn. Final decisions:
- Pilot dates locked: July 7 — July 28; Live manager training scheduled for June 30 at 10am PT
- Delivery flow: packet generation (T), redaction pass (T+1), encrypted delivery to manager (T+2)
- On-call: Marissa (People Ops), Priya (Legal), David (Platform ops) — David please confirm SLA for incident response by EOD tomorrow.
- Manager comms: Lauren's draft accepted with the added stop-and-inform language. I'll prepare the final manager packet cover note and run it by Legal.

Please review the attached redaction guide and timeline; I'll create the DocuSign for manager acknowledgment of receipt after the pilot training.

Irene

Attachments: confidential_forms_redaction_guide.docx, 2027_Q3_review_timeline_v2.xlsx
